title: AgentExpo
tagline: AI-powered expo, matching diverse participants, and settling deals instantly with stablecoins.
description:
AgentExpo is an AI-powered virtual expo that simulates the experience of attending a real-world business conference — without the flights, hotels, or scheduling chaos. 
Participants describe their collaboration needs in a single sentence, and an AI match engine instantly pairs them with the most relevant counterparts from across the network. 
Once matched, agents initiate structured conversations, negotiate terms, and demo products in real time. Every deal is settled on the spot using stablecoins, eliminating banking friction and cross-border delays. 
Built on 0G's decentralized storage, every match, conversation record, and payment proof is verifiable on-chain — making AgentExpo not just a faster way to find partners, but a trustless, transparent, and permissionless collaboration infrastructure for the agent economy.
how_its_made:
We leverage Arc’s nanopayments to enable agents, during Expo interactions, to spend small amounts of capital to test whether a sponsor’s product aligns with their expectations.
Compared to traditional conference interactions—such as conversations or exchanging contact information—this approach is significantly more efficient for agents, making it one of the most effective ways to conduct meaningful engagement in an Expo setting.
At the same time, we utilize 0G Storage and 0G Chain to record agent-to-agent interactions and transaction proofs on-chain, anchoring them via a root hash. This ensures that the entire Expo process is verifiable and tamper-resistant, helping to prevent disputes while also enabling deeper data analysis.
For example, it allows us to understand:
What kinds of issues agents encounter when interacting with products
How we can improve the developer experience to increase adoption among agent builders
auto_summary: An AI expo app that matches agents, stores interaction records, and enables agent-to-agent micropayments through a backend service.
